item1.justification: The trace applies single-reference, all-elements anticipation under §102, Graham-factor analysis under §103, and specification-support/claim-clarity inquiries under §112.

item2.justification: The conclusions identify specific claim limitations—such as PECVD USG, TEOS-based oxide, and Wc relative to Wt—and map them to particular claims of US-2013292791-A1 or paragraph 0022 of the specification.

item3.justification: The office action inconsistently rejects claims 1–19 under §102 while separately stating that claims 2, 7, 10, 15, and 18 are not rejected under §102 and contain allowable subject matter.

item4.justification: The examiner’s broad-interpretation profile and moderate strictness are reflected in reading explicit or implicit disclosures broadly while rejecting on strongly asserted anticipation and support defects rather than resolving ambiguity toward allowance.

item5.justification: The final rejection follows the accumulated §102 and §112 findings and expressly relies on the same reference, claim mappings, and specification-support deficiencies.
